rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by ACPE and for CME automatically qualify; other programs per ARM 24.174.2106 (10 hours = 1 CEU)
rules.audit_note: Renewal includes a CEU statement under ARM 24.174.2104; licensees may be audited.
rules.notes: 1.5 CEU per renewal period with at least 0.5 CEU in approved contact/group programs, or 2.0 CEU without them. Licenses expire June 30 (renewal May 2-June 30). Cycle length not confirmed: rule text on rules.mt.gov did not load.
rules.rule_quote: …1.5 CEU’s (10 hours equal one CEU) with 0.5 CEU obtained in an approved contact/group hours or 2.0 CEU if a pharmacist does not take at least 0.5 CEU in an approved contact/group program.
